carl_sales: Heads-up — AcmeCorp legal just asked for SOC2 artefacts + signed pen-test letter before we can spin up their POC. Also asking whether using Dedicated changes pricing for the trial. Can we get a quick list of what we can provide and any cost delta?

jamie_solutions: +1. We should confirm scope: they want SOC2 artifact set (controls matrix, CC-TA, sys diagrams), pen-test attestation, and whether logs can be retained for 90 days. Do we have a standard packet we can share? :file_folder:

tanya_security: I have a pen-test attestation template we can sign — it states we performed/reviewed an external pentest within the last 12 months and provides contact for verification. I can drop the signed copy once legal signs the NDA. For SOC2: we can share the SOC2 report summary and a controls matrix export (redacted where necessary). 90d logs: hosted API default retention is 30d for non-enterprise; Dedicated/Private customers can request 90d via add-on.

carl_sales: Customer is pushing for 90d during the POC to match their audit team. They asked if there is any immediate cost they will see during a 30-day POC on Dedicated vs Hosted.

infra_ops: Short answer: Hosted with our free credits -> no extra charge beyond usage. Dedicated requires a minimum reserved capacity for the POC (one pool) which has a short-term committed rate — I'll put rough numbers: ~ $Xk/day baseline for a tiny pool + per-token usage; up to 40% higher depending on instance class. I can spin up an estimate if you send expected concurrency/seq length.

jamie_solutions: For now, ask Acme for expected RPS and typical generation lengths (avg/95p). If they can't give it, ask for number of concurrent users and expected API calls per user. I can prepare a quick delta table for Hosted vs Dedicated.

carl_sales: I'll ping them. Also they want staging creds so their infra team can smoke test networking — prefer limited-time presigned URLs or temp SFTP?

tanya_security: We strongly prefer presigned S3 or ephemeral staging creds with scoped IAM roles. If they insist on SFTP, we can provide a managed SFTP drop with a one-time upload link — but that has more operational overhead. Presigned example we give:```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-compliance/acmecorp/pocevidence.zip --expires-in 86400
```

infra_ops: If we provide presigned uploads, we should also include a checksum and an object lifecycle to auto-delete after 7 days. I'll add that to the handoff checklist.

jamie_solutions: Attachments to share: SOC2-summary.pdf (redacted), controls-matrix.csv, pen-test-attestation-template.pdf, network-diagram.png. We should also give them a quick README explaining redactions and the expected SLA for Dedicated during POC.

uploads-bot: Uploaded "acme_poc_evidence_bucket/1766201234/" (4 files) — https://storage.internal/redwood/acme_poc_evidence_bucket/1766201234

carl_sales: Nice, thanks. @tanya_security can you prefill the pen-test attestation and mark fields we need legal to sign?

tanya_security: Yep — I'll prefill vendor/date/summary, and include a line for a legal POC signature. ETA 2 hours.

carl_sales: Also need a clear sentence for procurement: "Does starting a Dedicated POC carry any one-time onboarding fee or network egress commitments?"

infra_ops: One-time onboarding for a tiny Dedicated pool: operational setup (networking, VPC peering, KMS binding) usually billed as a fixed $2k <= cost <= $5k depending on cross-account network work. Egress billed per provider rates — call that out. I'll add a short blurb for the sales packet.

jamie_solutions: I'll draft a short email for legal/procurement and attach the packet. Draft will include: - what we can provide today (list) - what requires NDA or signed attestation - pricing delta and ops onboarding note - how to request 90d log retention during trial.

carl_sales: Perfect. Once draft is ready I can send to Acme. If they accept presigned uploads, can we put a watermark on the docs? (they asked for non-repudiation)

tanya_security: We can watermark PDFs during export. For editable docs we recommend a signed manifest file with SHA256 sums. Example manifest command:```
sha256sum acme_poc_evidence/* > manifest.sha256
```

carl_sales: Great. Thanks team — ping me when the pen-test attestation is prefilled and when the cost delta table is in the shared folder. I'll coordinate with Acme (they want a call tomorrow). :calendar:

jamie_solutions: Will do — I'll upload the delta table and the draft email by EOD. :thumbsup:

uploads-bot: Link updated: https://storage.internal/redwood/acme_poc_evidence_bucket/1766201234/delta_table.xlsx

carl_sales: Received. Closing loop after call.
